name: [FACTORY UPD!!!] Cubination
desc:
>> Please note that the game is in BETA <<
⚠️ Expect bugs, and frequent updates!

🎲 Drop cubes on top of cubes to combine them!
🔎 Not every cube combines… Use the Researcher to discover recipes!

--// 🌟 == Controls == 🌟 //--
Q → Drop  
F → Switch  

--// 🛠️ Tips & Features 🛠️ //--
-> Type /cmds in chat to see all available commands
-> Not every cube can be crafted… explore the map to unlock more cubes! 
-> Gems are cross-server, earn them in one server and spend them in another

--// 📢 Community Server Perks 📢 //--
-> Get notified when updates drop
-> Report bugs & players easily
-> Share suggestions to help shape the future of the game!

💖 This game is a fangame of “Cube Combination” by Izuki, check out the original here: https://www.roblox.com/games/9798463281
